name: find_sites
description: Score and rank parcels for a renewable project near a Kern County place, then show them on the map and results list.

place.description: A Kern County place, e.g. Mojave, Bakersfield, Tehachapi.

use_case.description: What to site. Defaults to utility_solar.

name: focus_map
description: Pan and zoom the map to a Kern County place without scoring.

name: check_affordability
description: Check live land affordability for the area: median home value, year-over-year price trend, and an affordability rating. County-level for Kern (the same figure regardless of the exact place).

place.description: A Kern County place for context (optional); the figure is county-wide.

name: explain_parcel
description: Explain why a specific parcel scored the way it did — its top contributing factors and any hard exclusions. Use a parcel id from a prior find_sites result.

parcel_id.description: The parcel id from a find_sites result.

name: grid_context
description: Summarize the CAISO interconnection queue for Kern County — total queued megawatts and the leading technologies. Background context, not part of scoring.

name: focus_parcel
description: Zoom and pan the map to a specific parcel and select it. Use a parcel id from a find_sites result.

parcel_id.description: The parcel id to zoom to.

name: export_pdf
description: Generate a downloadable PDF report of one or more parcels (score, factor breakdown, grid context). Pass comma-separated parcel ids, or leave empty for all parcels currently shown.

parcel_ids.description: Comma-separated parcel ids; empty means all shown.

name: set_map_view
description: Change what is shown on the map: toggle data layers on/off and/or switch the basemap (map mode). 'show'/'hide' take comma-separated layer names (parcels, transmission, substations, flood, suitability score) or 'all'/'none'. 'basemap' switches the map mode. Use it for requests like 'hide the flood layer', 'turn on transmission lines', or 'switch to satellite'.

show.description: Comma-separated layer names to TURN ON (parcels, transmission, substations, flood, suitability score), or 'all'.

hide.description: Comma-separated layer names to TURN OFF, or 'all'.

basemap.description: Basemap / map mode to switch to: auto, light, dark, streets, or satellite. Omit (or 'keep') to leave the current basemap unchanged.
